(sec-module-symbolics.kinematics)=
# Module: symbolics.kinematics

Rotation and kinematics functions for symbolic user functions (#3069): a selection of
exudyn.cUtilities / exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities with the same names and arguments, plus a last argument
functions, the module whose sin, cos, sqrt, ... are used. With functions=exudyn.symbolic (the default)
the arguments may be symbolic and the result is an exudyn.symbolic.Matrix or Vector, which a symbolic
user function records; with functions=numpy, math or exudyn.cMath they are numbers and the result is a
numpy array, equal to the one of cUtilities. So a user function is written once for both; for numbers
alone, exudyn.cUtilities is faster.
Arguments are sequences indexed by component: lists, numpy arrays, symbolic vectors or their slices.
The classes HT and Twist hold a frame and its velocities with symbolic parts, with the methods of
exudyn.HT and exudyn.Twist; PointVelocity, LocalTwist and RelativeTwist take either (#3182).

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-23 (created)

(sec-kinematics-skew)=
## Function: Skew

[`Skew(vector, functions = exu.symbolic)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L55)

- **function description**: skew symmetric 3 x 3 matrix of a 3D vector, Skew(a) @ b = a x b; equals exudyn.cUtilities.Skew for a 3D vector
- **input**:
  - `vector`: 3D vector
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 3 x 3 matrix, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array

- **function description**: time derivatives of the Euler parameters of the global angular velocity, 0.25 G^T @ angularVelocity for unit Euler parameters; equals exudyn.cUtilities.AngularVelocity2EulerParameters_t
- **input**:
  - `angularVelocity`: 3D global angular velocity
  - `eulerParameters`: 4 Euler parameters, entry 0 the scalar part
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 4D vector of the time derivatives of the Euler parameters, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array

(sec-kinematics-rotationvector2rotationmatrix)=
## Function: RotationVector2RotationMatrix

[`RotationVector2RotationMatrix(rotationVector, functions = exu.symbolic)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L361)

- **function description**: rotation matrix of the rotation vector v with the angle a = |v|, I + sin(a)/a Skew(v) + 2 sin(a/2)^2/a^2 Skew(v)^2, see appendix B in [Simo1988]; below a = 1e-12 the factors are their limits 1 and 1/2, for symbolic arguments chosen by exudyn.symbolic.IfThenElse; equals exudyn.cUtilities.RotationVector2RotationMatrix
- **input**:
  - `rotationVector`: 3D rotation vector
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 3 x 3 rotation matrix, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array

(sec-kinematics-pointvelocity)=
## Function: PointVelocity

[`PointVelocity(HT, twist, localPoint)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L701)

- **function description**: the velocity of a point fixed in the frame HT, given by its position in the frame, v + omega x (A localPoint); for an exudyn.HT and an exudyn.Twist computed by exudyn.cUtilities.PointVelocity
- **input**:
  - `HT`: the frame, an exudyn.HT or kinematics.HT
  - `twist`: the twist of the frame, an exudyn.Twist or kinematics.Twist
  - `localPoint`: 3D position of the point in the frame
- **output**: 3D velocity of the point, global components; symbolic for symbolic parts, else as np.array

## Function: LocalTwist

[`LocalTwist(HT, twist)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L717)

- **function description**: the twist in the components of the frame HT, [A^T v, A^T omega]; for an exudyn.HT and an exudyn.Twist computed by exudyn.cUtilities.LocalTwist
- **input**:
  - `HT`: the frame, an exudyn.HT or kinematics.HT
  - `twist`: the twist of the frame, an exudyn.Twist or kinematics.Twist
- **output**: the twist in local components, an exudyn.Twist for exudyn.HT and exudyn.Twist, else a kinematics.Twist


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicHTTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicHTTest.py) (TM)


(sec-kinematics-relativetwist)=
## Function: RelativeTwist

[`RelativeTwist(HT0, twist0, HT1, twist1)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L733)

- **function description**: the velocity of frame 1 relative to frame 0 in the components of frame 0, the time derivative of HT0.Relative(HT1): [A0^T (v1 - v0 - omega0 x (p1 - p0)), A0^T (omega1 - omega0)]; for exudyn.HT and exudyn.Twist computed by exudyn.cUtilities.RelativeTwist
- **input**:
  - `HT0`: frame 0, an exudyn.HT or kinematics.HT
  - `twist0`: the twist of frame 0, an exudyn.Twist or kinematics.Twist
  - `HT1`: frame 1
  - `twist1`: the twist of frame 1
- **output**: the relative twist, an exudyn.Twist for exudyn.HT and exudyn.Twist, else a kinematics.Twist


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicHTTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicHTTest.py) (TM)


(sec-module-symbolics.kinematics-class-ht)=
## CLASS HT (in module symbolics.kinematics)

**class description**: the homogeneous transformation of exudyn.HT for symbolic parts (#3174): a rotation matrix and a translation, each an exudyn.symbolic.Matrix or Vector, or numbers; its methods give the matrix and vector expressions at once, so that a recording holds matrix products. A symbolic user function of ObjectConnectorUser and ObjectJointUser gets one per marker while it is recorded, an exudyn.HT when it computes with numbers; both have the same methods. An exudyn.HT is taken as constant in the products, in either order.

- **input**:
  - `rotation`: 3 x 3 rotation matrix, None for the unit matrix; or an exudyn.HT or HT, copied
  - `translation`: 3D translation, None for zero

(sec-kinematics-ht-fromsymbolicarguments)=
### Class function: FromSymbolicArguments

[`FromSymbolicArguments(rotation = None, translation = None, eulerParameters = None, Rxyz = None, rotationVector = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L470)

- **class function description**: the HT of the arguments of exudyn.HT, some of them symbolic: exudyn.HT(...) gives it for symbolic arguments (#3186); the rotation from at most one of a 3x3 matrix, Euler parameters, Tait-Bryan angles Rxyz and a rotation vector, by the conversions of this module, or a copy of a kinematics.HT given as rotation
- **input**:
  - `rotation`: 3 x 3 rotation matrix, or a kinematics.HT to copy; None for the unit rotation
  - `translation`: 3D translation, None for zero
  - `eulerParameters`: the 4 Euler parameters of the rotation
  - `Rxyz`: the 3 Tait-Bryan angles of the rotation
  - `rotationVector`: the rotation vector of the rotation
- **output**: kinematics.HT


(sec-kinematics-ht---mul--)=
### Class function: __mul__

[`__mul__(self, other)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L502)

- **class function description**: H1*H2, the composition, an HT; H*v, the transformed point A v + p of a 3D vector


(sec-kinematics-ht---rmul--)=
### Class function: __rmul__

[`__rmul__(self, other)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L509)

- **class function description**: exudyn.HT * HT, the composition with the exudyn.HT as constant


(sec-kinematics-ht---matmul--)=
### Class function: __matmul__

[`__matmul__(self, other)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L515)

- **class function description**: H1@H2, the composition as H1*H2


(sec-kinematics-ht---rmatmul--)=
### Class function: __rmatmul__

[`__rmatmul__(self, other)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L521)

- **class function description**: exudyn.HT @ HT, the composition as exudyn.HT * HT


(sec-kinematics-ht-inverse)=
### Class function: Inverse

[`Inverse(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L525)

- **class function description**: the inverse transformation [A^T, -A^T p], an HT


(sec-kinematics-ht-relative)=
### Class function: Relative

[`Relative(self, other)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L530)

- **class function description**: the frame of other seen from this one, H.Inverse()*other = [A^T A2, A^T (p2 - p)], without the inverse


(sec-kinematics-ht--numbers)=
### Class function: _Numbers

[`_Numbers(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L538)

- **class function description**: the exudyn.HT of numeric parts, None for symbolic parts


(sec-kinematics-ht-getrotationvector)=
### Class function: GetRotationVector

[`GetRotationVector(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L544)

- **class function description**: the rotation as rotation vector (axis times angle), the rotation parameters of NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG; for symbolic parts from the skew part s and the trace of the rotation, angle = atan2(|s|, (trace - 1)/2), the factor angle/|s| by its limit 1 + |s|^2/6 below |s| = 1e-6; the angle must stay below pi, where the vector is not unique
- **output**: 3D rotation vector, symbolic for symbolic parts, else as np.array


(sec-kinematics-ht-getrxyz)=
### Class function: GetRxyz

[`GetRxyz(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L564)

- **class function description**: the rotation as the 3 Tait-Bryan angles [rotX, rotY, rotZ], the rotation parameters of NodeRigidBodyRxyz, as exudyn.HT computes them: at the singularity |cos(rotY)| < 1e-14 rotX is 0
- **output**: 3D vector of the angles, symbolic for symbolic parts, else as np.array


(sec-kinematics-ht-logr3xso3)=
### Class function: LogR3xSO3

[`LogR3xSO3(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L582)

- **class function description**: the logarithm on R3xSO(3): [translation, rotation vector], 6 components, as GetCoordinatesRotationVector
- **output**: 6D vector, symbolic for symbolic parts, else as np.array


(sec-kinematics-ht-setexpr3xso3)=
### Class function: SetExpR3xSO3

[`SetExpR3xSO3(self, vector)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L594)

- **class function description**: set from the exponential map on R3xSO(3) of [U, Omega], 6 components: the translation U and the rotation of the rotation vector Omega, each on its own; returns the HT


(sec-kinematics-ht-logse3)=
### Class function: LogSE3

[`LogSE3(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L606)

- **class function description**: the logarithm on SE(3): the motion vector [U, Omega], 6 components, from which SetExpSE3 gives this HT back; Omega is the rotation vector, U = TExpSO3Inv(Omega)^T p = beta p - Omega x p / 2 + gamma Omega (Omega . p) with beta = (phi/2) cot(phi/2), gamma = (1 - beta)/phi^2, by their series below phi = 0.02 as in exudyn.HT
- **output**: 6D vector, symbolic for symbolic parts, else as np.array


(sec-kinematics-ht-setexpse3)=
### Class function: SetExpSE3

[`SetExpSE3(self, vector)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L630)

- **class function description**: set from the exponential map on SE(3) of the motion vector [U, Omega], 6 components: the rotation of the rotation vector Omega and the translation TExpSO3(Omega)^T U = U - t1 Omega x U + t2 Omega x (Omega x U) with t1 = -(1 - cos(phi))/phi^2, t2 = (1 - sin(phi)/phi)/phi^2, by their series below phi = 0.01 as in exudyn.HT; returns the HT

(sec-module-symbolics.kinematics-class-twist)=
## CLASS Twist (in module symbolics.kinematics)

**class description**: the twist of exudyn.Twist for symbolic parts (#3174): the velocity of the origin of a frame and its angular velocity, both in global components, each an exudyn.symbolic.Vector or numbers. A symbolic forceUserFunction of ObjectConnectorUser gets one per marker while it is recorded, an exudyn.Twist when it computes with numbers.

- **input**:
  - `velocity`: 3D velocity of the origin, None for zero; or an exudyn.Twist or Twist, copied
  - `angularVelocity`: 3D angular velocity, None for zero

(sec-kinematics-twist-fromsymbolicarguments)=
### Class function: FromSymbolicArguments

[`FromSymbolicArguments(velocity = None, angularVelocity = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/kinematics.py#L673)

- **class function description**: the Twist of the arguments of exudyn.Twist, some of them symbolic: exudyn.Twist(...) gives it for symbolic arguments (#3186)
- **input**:
  - `velocity`: 3D velocity of the origin, or a kinematics.Twist to copy; None for zero
  - `angularVelocity`: 3D angular velocity, None for zero
- **output**: kinematics.Twist
